content.text: I thought we discussed the change represented in the above PR... and that you suggested the build breaks with this update. My build does not break. Thoughts?
Interesting – I thought I had tried that....
This PR also builds fine for me and deploys to karaf without errors. Shall I merge it?
@awoods an amendment to your PR is here:
PR-813 is again ready for review:
PR has been merged with master

Reopening this issue in order to chip away at some of the classes that break through the org.modeshape.jcr layer (removing those will constitute a true fix). I will start with org.modeshape.jcr.GetBinaryStore

I have a local branch with all of the org.modeshape.jcr.value.binary.* classes reimplemented using only the modeshape public API. That leaves the IsExternal and GetBinaryStore classes. Should I submit these PRs incrementally or all at once?
Separate commits in one PR makes sense.
This looks good, pending response to one minor code review comment.

The fcrepo-kernel-impl exports org.modeshape packages, which is especially problematic in an OSGi context. The code should be refactored in such a way that these org.modeshape packages are no longer exported.
